mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply shock that reduces corporate margins and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for the regime-specific interaction remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a strengthening economy that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in the labor market (PAYEMS growth below 0.5% YoY) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 1.0%) indicates an economy in distress, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS YoY growth < 0.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a collapse in consumer confidence and residential investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and HOUST declines, or Rank IC for the regime-specific interaction remains below 0.03.
